source: Synthetic alerts for Larkspur Supply (a fictional shop), written for this recipe and shaped like the alerts in a Prometheus Alertmanager webhook: labels plus annotations. These are the alerts no Alertmanager route matched, so they reached the fallback receiver.

annotations.description: POST /v1/charges returns 502 from the card provider.
Product pages slow for all regions.

annotations.summary: PostgreSQL replica is 340s behind the primary
annotations.description: Streaming replication lag on the read replica keeps growing; WAL replay is stalled.

annotations.summary: Kafka consumer group loyalty-points is 85,000 messages behind on topic order-events
annotations.description: Consumer lag has grown for 20 minutes; partitions 3 and 7 have no active consumer.

annotations.summary: TLS certificate for shop.larkspur.example expires in 6 days
annotations.description: cert-manager failed to renew the ingress certificate: ACME challenge timed out.

annotations.summary: Synthetic check 'smoke-7' failed 3 times in a row
Disk usage 91% on data node es-data-2 (high watermark 90%)
annotations.description: Shards can no longer be allocated to this node; the database disk keeps filling.
Job exited with code 137 after 41 minutes.

annotations.summary: Failed logins at 9x the usual rate over 15m
annotations.description: Most failures are 'invalid OAuth token' on the sign-in endpoint; password resets are also up.
The checkout-v3 build returns HTTP 500 on the order review step for some carts.

annotations.summary: Kafka broker kafka-4 has 38 under-replicated partitions
annotations.description: Follower replicas on broker kafka-4 keep dropping out of the in-sync replica set; the broker's disk is slow.
